intent: Six supplementary medium-detail environment references for adapting the existing NFS World Downtown Rockport map. Generated concepts, not in-engine captures or UV atlas assets.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3D environment adaptation reference for coding agents who already have the NFS World / Downtown Rockport models and textures imported from an Assetto Corsa mod. All THREE input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY and define the same middle-ground style; do not copy their scene layout. Match them closely: grounded medium-detail low-poly 3D racing environment, realistic human/vehicle scale, simple substantial architecture, slightly faceted rocks and props, modest rough texture detail, angular irregular autumn foliage with natural broken silhouettes, muted ochre/russet and gray/beige palette, warm diffuse cloudy-afternoon light, cool gray-blue shadows and modest haze. Match their fidelity, neither reduce to naked flat polygon blocks nor escalate to photorealistic polished graphics. Use moderate texture-only seams and broad localized wear, structural modeling where silhouette matters, smooth limited highlights only on glass/paint/metal. Matte dry ground. Natural cloudy sky, not polygon patch clouds. Serious worn urban setting, not cute, toy-like, chibi, voxel or whimsical. Output is a crisp wide 16:9 real-time-style render with no HUD, diagrams, annotations, text, title, watermark, collage, depth of field, motion blur, lens flare or glossy cinematic polish. Keep fine detail subordinate to large volumes. These are visual art references, not tileable texture assets or UV templates. Primary request: a CLOSE environmental detail study of an ordinary Rockport roadway viewed obliquely from sidewalk height, showing about 12 metres of road, curb and roadside barrier. Foreground clearly shows the transition between restrained rough charcoal asphalt, faded yellow lane paint, concrete curb sections and narrow dull paving strip. A weathered concrete traffic barrier and a simple dark metal guardrail occupy midground; low warehouse masses and ochre trees behind supply style context but stay secondary. Moderate seams, sparse broad pavement repairs, clean consistent hard edges and plausible barrier/curb proportions. Asphalt must retain a faint low-contrast grain; do not render individual gravel, endless tiny cracks, high-frequency noise or huge polygon-color mosaics. This image tells an agent how to adapt existing road textures and preserve road-edge geometry.

Primary request: a CLOSE three-quarter architectural study of a roughly 15-metre-wide Downtown Rockport warehouse/street facade. Show subdued rust-brown brick piers, broad warm-gray concrete bands, a simple row of dark windows with modest cloudy reflections, corrugated metal cladding on one side, a ribbed roller door and a shadowed entrance. Realistic scale, slightly asymmetric assembled modules, no signage or readable text. Keep masonry joints and metal ribbing understated and texture-based, windows broad and dark, trim simple. Moderate surface wear and a few repairs; no individual modeled bricks, immaculate showroom facade, ornate moldings, tiny hinges or photographic grime. Show enough pavement and a partial ochre crown for context. This image tells an agent the target balance of facade texture simplification and retained structural geometry.

Near tree silhouette and chunky branch structure are legible; medium trees show the same leaf-density language; distant trees reduce to quieter ochre masses. Grass and soil have restrained broad texture, no individual blades or pebbles. Same moderate material/geometry detail as supplied references. This image tells an agent how to restyle imported foliage cards, alpha silhouettes, trunks and terrain without turning trees into cute polyhedra.
